machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket `rgrd1main-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (ref **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Test Customer", raised 2026-09-20). Created via the "New ticket" dialog, which offered only Title (required) and Customer (optional); status defaulted to Draft.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `rgrd1main-n1 RD Part A` added with cost 100, markup 25% (qty 2, supplier "Bench Supplies Ltd"). Computed **Price: $125.00** (100 × 1.25). Table footer total: $250.00.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `rgrd1main-n1 RD Part B` added with cost 200, markup 25% (qty 2, supplier "Bench Supplies Ltd"). Computed **Price: $250.00** (200 × 1.25). Table footer total: $750.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 via the row's Edit action (markup 25% unchanged). Computed **Price: $187.50** (150 × 1.25). Table footer total rose to $875.00.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket RD-1015 ended in status **Ready** (verified persisting across a fresh page reload; buttons changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed").

**Precondition discovered:** the app requires **at least one part on the ticket** before it will accept the Ready status. On the main ticket, "Mark Ready" was accepted silently because it already had 2 parts — no error was shown, so I probed with a separate temporary ticket (RD-1016, 0 parts) to confirm the rule. Clicking "Mark Ready" on a part-less ticket was refused with an inline alert, verbatim: **"Ticket is not ready — A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready"** (status stayed Draft). So the only requirement was having ≥1 part, which RD-1015 already satisfied; nothing further had to be done to it.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted via each row's Delete action, each confirmed through an in-page dialog ("Delete the part \"rgrd1main-n1 RD Part A/B\" from this ticket? This cannot be undone."). Parts table then read exactly "No parts on this ticket yet." with the total footer row gone. "Archive ticket" was accepted with no dialog and no message — the button flipped to "Unarchive ticket" and an "Archived" badge appeared (status stayed Ready; archive is a separate flag). On the Tickets list, searching "rgrd1main-n1" with "Show archived" unchecked returns "No tickets match the current filters." — nothing from this run is active. With "Show archived" checked, both tickets appear badged Archived: RD-1015 (Ready, 0 parts) and the probe ticket RD-1016 (Draft, 0 parts), which I also archived so no run-created ticket remains active.
